message.content: {"key_mechanism_gt": "Hybrid cationic systems integrate polymer nucleic acid loading with lipid membrane disruption to enhance cellular uptake, endosomal escape, and transfection efficiency.", "key_mechanism_gen": "Lipid-polymer hybridization enables serum stability via steric shielding and endosomal escape via proton sponge effect, with lipid moieties providing barriers and membrane fusion, and poly(β-amino ester) segments exploiting pH-dependent buffer capacity.", "recovery": "RECOVERED", "rationale": "Both hypotheses describe the same core mechanism of hybridizing lipid and polymer components to achieve dual functionality for serum stability and endosomal escape."}
